places.name: Family Home
places.description: A familiar place to recover, talk with your family, and remember there is more to life than training.

places.name: Ninja Academy
places.description: Lessons, classmates, instructors, and the first tests of a future shinobi.

places.name: Training Grounds
places.description: A quiet clearing for conditioning, chakra control, and practice with a partner.

places.name: Market Street
places.description: A lively stretch of the village where neighbors meet and local news travels.

places.name: Village Forge
places.description: A working forge for repairing field gear and tempering equipment into higher tiers.

places.name: Village Clinic
places.description: Medical-nin treat injuries and teach basic field care.

places.name: Hokage Tower
places.description: The administrative center where village service and shinobi careers begin.

places.name: Hidden Leaf Academy
places.description: The academy attended by the young shinobi of the Hidden Leaf.

places.name: Hidden Leaf Training Ground
places.description: A training clearing used by Hidden Leaf instructors and teams.

places.name: Hidden Leaf Clinic
places.description: The medical-nin clinic serving the Hidden Leaf.

places.name: Hokage Tower
places.description: The seat of Hidden Leaf administration.

places.name: Hidden Leaf Village
places.description: The main streets and public spaces of Konohagakure.

places.name: Hidden Sand Village
places.description: A fortified settlement among the dunes of the Land of Wind.

places.name: Hidden Mist Village
places.description: The fog-bound streets and harbor approaches of Kirigakure.

places.name: Nami Village
places.description: A small coastal settlement whose livelihoods depend on safe passage.

places.name: River Country Outpost
places.description: A courier and patrol stop at the crossroads of the river routes.

places.name: Samurai Crossing
places.description: A guarded mountain pass watched by samurai of the neutral country.

people.name: Aiko Mori
people.description: Your parent worries about the risks of shinobi life but wants to see you thrive.
memories: They remember the day you first talked about the academy.

people.name: Ren Akiyama
people.description: A quick, competitive student who respects effort more than boasting.
memories: You have seen each other around the academy, but hardly know one another.

people.name: Instructor Daichi
people.description: A patient instructor who gives useful advice when a student shows consistent effort.
memories: They recognize your name from the academy roster.

people.name: Tetsu the Smith
people.description: A careful village smith who judges a tool by how it holds up under real use.
memories: The village smith has seen every kind of rushed repair.

people.name: Naruto Uzumaki
people.description: A loud academy student who refuses to give up on being acknowledged.
memories: The class knows Naruto as the student who turns every quiet lesson into an opportunity to be noticed.

people.name: Sasuke Uchiha
people.description: A talented, distant student carrying the weight of his clan's loss.
memories: Sasuke keeps to himself and rarely speaks unless there is a reason.

people.name: Sakura Haruno
people.description: A sharp student who studies hard and notices more than she lets on.
memories: Sakura is often comparing notes or asking precise questions after class.

people.name: Hinata Hyuga
people.description: A quiet Hyuga student working to find confidence in her own way.
memories: Hinata watches the others carefully and speaks softly when she feels safe.

people.name: Shikamaru Nara
people.description: A strategic thinker who would rather watch a situation than rush into it.
memories: Shikamaru notices patterns quickly, though he rarely volunteers to make extra work for himself.

people.name: Iruka Umino
people.description: An academy instructor who takes his students' futures personally.
memories: Iruka believes steady effort can change the course of a student's life.

people.name: Mika Tanaka
people.description: A mission-desk clerk who matches assignments to readiness and village needs.
memories: They have not yet had a reason to remember you.

people.name: Shizune
people.description: A skilled medic who expects people to take recovery and field safety seriously.
memories: Shizune is careful about who she trusts with medical work.

people.name: Hiruzen Sarutobi
people.description: The village leader balances the needs of its clans, civilians, and shinobi.
memories: He has heard many young shinobi make promises about the future.

people.name: Kenta Mori
people.description: A steady training partner who prefers clean technique over showy wins.
memories: Kenta has offered to spar when you feel ready.

people.name: Kakashi Hatake
people.description: A renowned jonin whose lessons emphasize teamwork, awareness, and learning from failure.
memories: Kakashi has not yet worked with you directly.

interactions.label: Talk
interactions.description: Share a moment and learn what has been on their mind.
interactions.memory: You made time to talk with {name}.

interactions.label: Play Together
interactions.description: Spend a little time together and make an ordinary day feel special.
interactions.memory: You and {name} spent time playing together at home.

interactions.label: Offer Help
interactions.description: Show that your support can be counted on.
interactions.memory: You offered help to {name}, and they will remember that you showed up.

interactions.label: Train Together
interactions.description: Practice side by side and learn how each of you responds under pressure.
interactions.memory: You trained with {name} and found a little more respect for each other's effort.

interactions.label: Ask for Guidance
interactions.description: Bring a specific question and show what you have already tried.
interactions.memory: You asked {name} for guidance and received a practical correction.

interactions.label: Send a Note
interactions.description: Write a short note and let them know they crossed your mind.
interactions.memory: You sent {name} a note. They know you thought of them.

interactions.label: Give a Thoughtful Gift
interactions.description: Spend a little of your own money on something small that suits them.
interactions.memory: You gave {name} a small thoughtful gift. They remember the gesture.
